name: claude
title: Anthropic review interface
summary: Adds mandatory-by-policy cross-family review of OpenAI-authored campaigns through a fresh Claude CLI session, plus an optional Anthropic planning counterpart.

bin: claude (Claude CLI) - for reviewer-claude and planner-claude
env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an authenticated Claude CLI login

notes: OpenAI-authored campaigns route to reviewer-claude by default when this pack is installed.
A failed Claude lane is REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE, never approval; route to the fresh-context native OpenAI reviewer and report the cross-family fallback.
